data.gender_notes: Alhan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Who Bestows Favors, The One Who Gives Graciousness. The name Alhan carries the meaning “The One Giving Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Alhan usually hope their child will grow to embody the one giving grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Alhan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Giving Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alhan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
